I work in AI R&D, between research and production. After a PhD in statistics on Langevin
sampling, I spent six years building deep learning systems in industry — signal
processing at Thales, drug discovery at Iktos, foundation models for biology at MBZUAI
and GenBio AI — and LLM systems as a freelancer. I am now a postdoctoral researcher at
CREST with Arnak Dalalyan, working on two things: the mathematics of generative models,
and human–AI collaboration in mathematical research, through
[Human–AI Mathematics](https://human-ai-mathematics.github.io/), an open framework in
which AI agents search for and cross-review proofs that mathematicians can check. What I
care about is taking an idea from paper to working system, and measuring whether it
actually works.
